_source: intersect the per-spell presentation handler table (0x51d01) with the play_sfx call-site inventory, 2026-09-07
_method: a spell's handler owns the address range from its entry to the next distinct handler entry; any play_sfx call site inside that range belongs to that spell
_limit: only sites with a LITERAL index are resolvable this way; register-computed indices and the 13 dynamic-table_ptr sites still need separate work. Spells whose handler contains no call site simply do not play a pooled sfx from their own handler.
